source.title: Parallel and interactive learning processes within the basal ganglia: relevance for the understanding of addiction.

confidence_rationale: Authoritative Cambridge (Everitt/Robbins) review that names the exact symbol REE imported -- the serial, dopamine-dependent striato-nigro-striatal ascending spiral (Haber 2000 lineage) carrying information ventral(limbic)->dorsal(motor) through segregated cortico-striato-pallido-thalamo-cortical loops. Its highest value here is the FAILURE-MODE mapping: the review's whole thesis is that when this ascending spiral is driven UNCHECKED (by addictive drugs subverting the normal bounding), it produces a pathological runaway -- a compulsive, stimulus-response 'incentive habit' in which the dorsal-motor loop is progressively captured. That is the biological instance of exactly the 711 runaway (limbic drive climbing the spiral without a homeostatic bound and monopolising downstream selection). Direction 'mixed' not 'supports' because the review is a conceptual synthesis (no measured bounding law) and its addiction framing is a divergence-flavoured caveat: the spiral's DEFAULT healthy operation is bounded/graded; runaway is the pathology. Confidence 0.66: high source quality, strong mapping to the symbol + its failure mode, but indirect on the quantitative bound.
failure_signatures: If the ascending limbic->motor spiral is driven without the normal homeostatic constraint (the drug-subversion analogue = REE's unbounded raw scalar gain), the dorsal/motor loop is progressively captured and behaviour collapses onto a single compulsive stimulus-response channel -- the biological form of the 711 limbic-monopoly runaway.

The spiral's benefit is contingent on it staying GRADED and serial (ventral biases dorsal by a bounded increment); a mechanism that lets one loop's ascending drive grow without bound produces maladaptive habit-capture, not adaptive integration.

mapping.source_claim_statement: The basal ganglia are organised as segregated parallel cortico-striato-pallido-thalamo-cortical loops, but a serial, dopamine-dependent striato-nigro-striatal ascending spiral propagates information from ventral (nucleus accumbens / limbic) to progressively more dorsal (motor) striatum; protracted addictive-drug exposure recruits and amplifies this ascending spiral, shifting control from action-outcome to compulsive stimulus-response habit.
mapping.ree_translation: This is the biological source of ARC-110's segregated-loops-plus-ascending-integration design and of the ASG (ascending-spiral gain) mechanism REE built. Crucially it grounds the DIVERGENCE ledger: the biological spiral is a BOUNDED graded modulation whose pathological UNBOUNDING (addiction) produces a single-loop runaway -- the same shape as V3-EXQ-711's limbic monopoly. It converts ASG-3 from 'honest simplification' into a grounded divergence: the raw-scalar gain lacked the homeostatic bound that keeps the biological spiral out of the addiction-like runaway regime.
mapping.mapping_caveat: The review documents the spiral and its drug-driven runaway anatomically/behaviourally; it does NOT supply the homeostatic control law that bounds the healthy spiral (that is pillar-1 autoreceptor lit). Mapping addiction-as-runaway onto a gain-controller blow-up is an interpretive analogy between a neuroadaptive pathology and a numerical instability, not an identity.
mapping.source_context: Narrative review of rodent/primate basal-ganglia learning and addiction neuroscience; no REE-facing measurement.

confidence_components.notes: Source quality high (canonical group). Mapping fidelity good for the symbol + failure mode; transfer risk moderate-high because the bounding LAW is not in this paper and addiction->numerical-runaway is an analogy.
